agent_instructions: Use a disposable Linux host with a cached Ubuntu Server image. The CLI selector is sw-linux-lifecycle-a1b2 and its full libvirt domain is ubuntu-server-amd64-sw-linux-lifecycle-a1b2-dev-alchemy. All steps use qemu:///system. Proceed with creation only if the pre-create inventory succeeds and the full domain is absent. Destroy only the VM created for this request, including after failure. Save the pre-create and post-destroy inventories with their exit codes to logs/cleanup.txt.
test_commands: inventory=$(virsh --connect qemu:///system list --all --name) && printf '%s\n' "$inventory" | awk '$0 == "ubuntu-server-amd64-sw-linux-lifecycle-a1b2-dev-alchemy" { found = 1 } { print } END { exit (found ? 1 : 0) }'
DEV_ALCHEMY_LIBVIRT_URI=qemu:///system ./sailwright create ubuntu --type server --arch amd64 --name sw-linux-lifecycle-a1b2
DEV_ALCHEMY_LIBVIRT_URI=qemu:///system ./sailwright start ubuntu --type server --arch amd64 --name sw-linux-lifecycle-a1b2
DEV_ALCHEMY_LIBVIRT_URI=qemu:///system ./sailwright destroy ubuntu --type server --arch amd64 --name sw-linux-lifecycle-a1b2

inventory=$(virsh --connect qemu:///system list --all --name) && printf '%s\n' "$inventory" | awk '$0 == "ubuntu-server-amd64-sw-linux-lifecycle-a1b2-dev-alchemy" { found = 1 } { print } END { exit (found ? 1 : 0) }'
